# Golden export textprotos

Generated by the app's `UserMetadataBuilder` — the export contract
between Eclipsa Studio and the iamf-tools encoder, pinned from both
sides:

- `app/test/export/user_metadata_golden_test.dart` fails if the builder
  stops producing these bytes (regenerate with
  `flutter test test/export/user_metadata_golden_test.dart
  --dart-define=updateGoldens=true` from `app/`).
- `engine/test/cli_commands_test.cc` (`CliEncode.Golden*`) encodes each
  file through the real iamf-tools encoder and probes the result, so an
  iamf-tools pin bump that changes the proto surface fails here instead
  of at user export time. (`bed714.textproto` gets its encode + probe
  round trip from `iamf_loudness_agreement_test.cc` instead.)

| File | Scenario |
|---|---|
| `objects_binaural.textproto` | Base-Advanced: mono + dual object with non-origin POLAR / DUAL_POLAR positions and a non-default binaural filter profile (ES-283). |
| `multi_mix.textproto` | Base-Enhanced: two mix presentations over the same beds with different element subsets and distinct element/output mix gains (ES-285). |
| `multi_mix_opus.textproto` | The multi-mix session re-encoded as Opus — pins the Opus codec config contract (ES-382). |
| `bed714.textproto` | Base-Enhanced: one 7.1.4 bed, loudness declared on both a Stereo and a 7.1.4 layout — the loudness agreement test's multichannel cell (ES-514). |

Do not edit by hand — the Dart golden test defines the source configs.
After regenerating, re-run `bazel test //...` to re-prove the round
trip.
